title: The Mayoral Tiebreaker
logline: A dead-heat municipal vote activates an obscure charter proviso awarding office to whichever candidate deposits the station's founding bell on the dais, unaware the clause was a satirical joke that dissolves the mayoralty.

roles.description: A popular dockside organiser running on port tariff relief; loud, optimistic, and prone to acting before checking the bylaws.
The sitting habitat manager who prides himself on unbroken protocol; secretly terrified of administrative scandal.
A port authority security cutter charged with keeping transit corridors clear around the civic chamber.
An unpressurized storage chamber in an abandoned industrial ring housing colonial artifacts and brass regalia.
The central elevated platform where municipal elections are certified and charter oaths are sworn.

public_situation: A municipal election in {system} ends in an exact tie, prompting port arbiters to invoke an unamended century-old charter rule requiring physical delivery of the station's founding bell to the council dais.
private_truth: The bell is genuine, but the tiebreaker proviso was drafted as a satirical joke clause by the station founders, legally dissolving the mayor's office and transferring all revenues to the dockworkers if ever triggered.

beats.public_change: Sirens sound across the concourse as officials confirm a tied ballot and announce the ceremonial bell race.

missions.reason: She needs an outside pilot to fly to the unpressurized relic vault and secure the heavy brass founding bell before port security seals the access hatch.
missions.private_fact: Her campaign spent its last credits on election posters, so she is paying the pilot out of pooled shift tokens.

beats.public_change: The incumbent administrator posts emergency legal injunctions across the concourse while archivists review the colonial charter.

missions.reason: He hires an independent pilot to rush the original unsealed charter scrolls to the dais so his legal clerks can lodge a formal procedural injunction.
missions.private_fact: His legal team just discovered the joke clause and he wants the document placed under judicial seal before anyone reads the dissolution penalty aloud.

beats.public_change: Leaked excerpts of the charter scroll begin circulating among dock crews, who gather outside the council chamber to watch the dais.

missions.reason: She needs the pilot to scan the dais acoustic resonance sensors to verify whether depositing the bell will automatically broadcast the founder's dissolution decree.
missions.private_fact: She now knows about the joke clause and is torn between taking executive power or triggering the total dissolution of the municipal seat.

beats.public_change: The midnight election deadline looms while armed port security cutters form an interception cordon around the central council bay.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to push through the patrol cordon and reach the dais before the midnight deadline expires.
missions.private_fact: The patrol commander hails mid-fight offering municipal immunity and a heavy fuel voucher if the pilot jettisons the bell into the recycling slip instead.

player_choice.prompt: With the cordon cleared and the founding bell at the dais, the pilot must choose whether to strike the podium or hold back.

options.label: Strike the bell on the dais to trigger the founder's joke dissolution clause
Withhold the bell until both candidates agree to form a joint emergency council

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot breaks the patrol cordon and strikes the founding bell on the council dais.
resolutions.summary: The bell rings, triggering the founder's joke clause. The municipal office is formally dissolved, leaving station dockworkers in control of port revenues.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot rang an ancient tiebreaker bell, accidentally dissolving the station government under a century-old joke clause.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the patrol commander's bribe and jettisons the bell before reaching the dais.
resolutions.summary: The deadline passes with no bell deposited. {role:incumbent_administrator} declares the charter lapsed and retains power by emergency municipal decree.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot took a security payout to discard the founding bell, letting the old administration stay in power.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot confronts both candidates with the dissolution clause and forces a shared power agreement.
resolutions.summary: Confronted by mutual ruin under the joke clause, both candidates agree to lock the bell away and govern {system} through an uneasy joint coalition.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot threatened to trigger an ancient municipal joke clause, forcing rival politicians to govern together.

resolutions.summary: No bell reaches the dais before midnight. {role:incumbent_administrator} suspends the election indefinitely, prompting wildcat strikes across the freight docks.

loose_threads.detail: A handwritten appendix in the station's founding charter notes an unpaid debt to an unregistered salvage syndicate.
The parchment case holding the charter scroll bears an archival seal dated six months before the current election began.

radio_hooks: Municipal election in {system} deadlocked; century-old bell race charter clause invoked.
Dockworkers rally outside council dais as founding charter dissolution rumors spread.
Port administration denies security patrols were ordered to intercept election artifacts.

voice_direction.reformist_candidate: Boisterous and rapid-fire, frequently speaking in slogans. Stumbles into defensive stammering when asked about the charter fine print.
voice_direction.incumbent_administrator: Dry, punctilious, and relies on formal legalistic euphemisms. Becomes shrill and overly deliberate when discussing the founding dais.
